title: "CM distributions - viromeLib (Flaviviridae)"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Desktop/viromelib")
```

```{r paths}
ROOT     <- "~/Desktop/viromelib"
csv_path <- file.path(ROOT, "work/123_peaks_annotated.csv")
TBLOUT   <- file.path(ROOT, "work/06_infernal/tblout")
fig_dir  <- file.path(ROOT, "work/flaviOUT/figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

TBLS <- c(
  "cl1a xrRNA" = file.path(TBLOUT, "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm.tbl"),
  "cl1b xrRNA" = file.path(TBLOUT, "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm.tbl"),
  "cl2 xrRNA"  = file.path(TBLOUT, "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm.tbl")
)

missing <- TBLS[!file.exists(TBLS)]
if (length(missing) > 0)
  stop("Missing tblout files — run cmsearch first:\n",
       paste(" ", missing, collapse = "\n"))

# Thresholds
MIN_PVALUE <- 1e-10
MIN_SF     <- 0.2

# Only include significant hits (inc == "!"); set FALSE to include marginal "?"
SIG_ONLY <- TRUE

CM_LEVELS  <- c("cl1a xrRNA", "cl1b xrRNA", "cl2 xrRNA", "Unannotated")
CM_COLOURS <- c(
  "cl1a xrRNA"  = "#378ADD",
  "cl1b xrRNA"  = "#1D9E75",
  "cl2 xrRNA"   = "#D85A30",
  "Unannotated" = "#B4B2A9"
)

CSV_CM_COLS <- list(
  "cl1a xrRNA" = "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "cl1b xrRNA" = "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "cl2 xrRNA"  = "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm_hit"
)
```

---

## 1. Load peaks CSV and identify Flaviviridae accessions

Note: "Unannotated" genus includes sequences not formally assigned to a genus
(insect-specific flaviviruses etc.) plus "Anopheles flavivirus Liberia/2013",
which is a species-level NCBI label rather than a true genus designation.

```{r load_csv}
raw <- read.csv(csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Total peaks in CSV:      ", nrow(raw), "\n")
cat("Total unique accessions: ", n_distinct(raw$accession), "\n\n")

flavi_meta <- raw %>%
  filter(family == "Flaviviridae") %>%
  select(accession, genus, species) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(genus = ifelse(
    is.na(genus) | genus == "" | genus == "Anopheles flavivirus Liberia/2013",
    "Unannotated", genus
  ))
print(count(flavi_meta, genus, sort = TRUE))

cat("\nUnannotated genus — species-level identities:\n")
flavi_meta %>%
  filter(genus == "Unannotated") %>%
  select(accession, species) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

---

## 2. Parse cmsearch tblout files

cmsearch was run separately in conda env before knitting. tblout column 16 = E-value, 17 = inc ("!" significant, "?" marginal).

```{r parse_tblout}
read_tblout <- function(path, cm_label) {
  lines <- readLines(path)
  lines <- lines[!startsWith(lines, "#") & nchar(trimws(lines)) > 0]
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(lines, function(l) {
    p <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
    data.frame(
      accession = p[1],
      E_value   = as.numeric(p[16]),
      score     = as.numeric(p[15]),
      inc       = p[17],
      cm_class  = cm_label,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

cm_all <- do.call(rbind, mapply(read_tblout, TBLS, names(TBLS),
                                SIMPLIFY = FALSE))

cat("All cmsearch hits (all sequences, ! = significant, ? = marginal):\n")
print(with(cm_all, table(cm_class, inc)))
```

---

## 3. Input: CM annotation of Flaviviridae accessions

Each accession assigned to the CM class with the best (lowest) E-value across
all three models. `SIG_ONLY = TRUE` uses only `!` hits.

```{r input_cm}
cm_flavi <- cm_all %>%
  filter(accession %in% flavi_meta$accession) %>%
  { if (SIG_ONLY) filter(., inc == "!") else . }

# Per accession: best (lowest) E-value across all CMs
cm_best <- cm_flavi %>%
  group_by(accession) %>%
  slice_min(E_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join to full accession list; unmatched = Unannotated
acc_input <- flavi_meta %>%
  left_join(cm_best %>% select(accession, cm_class, E_value),
            by = "accession") %>%
  mutate(
    cm_class = ifelse(is.na(cm_class), "Unannotated", cm_class),
    cm_class = factor(cm_class, levels = CM_LEVELS)
  )

# Genus order by total accessions descending (used for both plots)
genus_order <- acc_input %>%
  count(genus, sort = TRUE) %>%
  pull(genus)

cat("=== INPUT: CM annotation (n =", nrow(acc_input), "accessions) ===\n\n")

input_cm_totals <- count(acc_input, cm_class) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
print(input_cm_totals)
write.csv(input_cm_totals,
          file.path(fig_dir, "viromeLib_flavi_input_cm_totals.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

unann_total <- input_cm_totals %>% filter(cm_class == "Unannotated")
cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d input accessions (%.1f%%) have no CM hit (Unannotated)\n",
            unann_total$n, sum(input_cm_totals$n), unann_total$pct))

input_cm_by_genus <- acc_input %>%
  count(genus, cm_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cm_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
cat("\nBy genus:\n")
print(input_cm_by_genus, n = Inf)
write.csv(input_cm_by_genus,
          file.path(fig_dir, "viromeLib_flavi_input_cm_by_genus.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

---

## 4. Output: filtered and deduplicated stall sites

`peak_position_id` = `accession|stall_position` (feature-relative). Rows
sharing the same `peak_position_id` are the same stall on different overlapping
tiles — keep the one with the best (lowest) `meta_pvalue`.

```{r output_stalls}
flavi_all <- raw %>%
  filter(family == "Flaviviridae") %>%
  mutate(genus = ifelse(
    is.na(genus) | genus == "" | genus == "Anopheles flavivirus Liberia/2013",
    "Unannotated", genus
  ))

flavi_filt <- flavi_all %>%
  filter(
    meta_pvalue       <= MIN_PVALUE,
    median_treated_sf >= MIN_SF
  ) %>%
  arrange(meta_pvalue) %>%
  distinct(peak_position_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    cm_class = {
      evals <- c(
        "cl1a xrRNA" = .data[[CSV_CM_COLS[["cl1a xrRNA"]]]],
        "cl1b xrRNA" = .data[[CSV_CM_COLS[["cl1b xrRNA"]]]],
        "cl2 xrRNA"  = .data[[CSV_CM_COLS[["cl2 xrRNA"]]]]
      )
      evals <- evals[!is.na(evals)]
      if (length(evals) == 0) "Unannotated" else names(which.min(evals))
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cm_class = factor(cm_class, levels = CM_LEVELS),
    genus    = factor(genus, levels = genus_order)
  )

cat("=== OUTPUT: filtering summary ===\n")
cat("Flaviviridae rows unfiltered:      ", nrow(flavi_all), "\n")
cat("After p <=", MIN_PVALUE, "and sf >=", MIN_SF, ":",
    nrow(filter(flavi_all, meta_pvalue <= MIN_PVALUE,
                median_treated_sf >= MIN_SF)), "\n")
cat("After dedup (unique stall sites):  ", nrow(flavi_filt), "\n")
cat("Accessions with >=1 stall:         ", n_distinct(flavi_filt$accession), "\n\n")

output_cm_totals <- count(flavi_filt, cm_class) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
print(output_cm_totals)
write.csv(output_cm_totals,
          file.path(fig_dir, "viromeLib_flavi_output_cm_totals.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

unann_total <- output_cm_totals %>% filter(cm_class == "Unannotated")
cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d stall sites (%.1f%%) have no CM hit (Unannotated)\n",
            unann_total$n, sum(output_cm_totals$n), unann_total$pct))

output_cm_by_genus <- flavi_filt %>%
  count(genus, cm_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cm_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
cat("\nBy genus:\n")
print(output_cm_by_genus, n = Inf)
write.csv(output_cm_by_genus,
          file.path(fig_dir, "viromeLib_flavi_output_cm_by_genus.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nPer-accession stall counts:\n")
stalls_per_acc <- flavi_filt %>%
  count(accession, genus, cm_class, name = "n_stalls") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_stalls))
print(stalls_per_acc, n = Inf)
write.csv(stalls_per_acc,
          file.path(fig_dir, "viromeLib_flavi_output_stalls_per_accession.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

---

## 5. Figures

### 5a. Input: accessions per genus coloured by CM class

```{r fig_input, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4}
p_input <- acc_input %>%
  count(genus, cm_class) %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genus, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CM_COLOURS, name = "CM class", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Input: ", nrow(flavi_meta),
                   " Flaviviridae accessions — cmsearch CM annotation"),
    x = NULL, y = "Accessions"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 10))

print(p_input)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "input_flaviviridae_accessions_cm.pdf"),
       p_input, width = 6.5, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "input_flaviviridae_accessions_cm.png"),
       p_input, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

### 5b. Output: stall sites per genus coloured by CM class

```{r fig_output, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4}
p_output <- flavi_filt %>%
  count(genus, cm_class) %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genus, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CM_COLOURS, name = "CM class", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Output: ", nrow(flavi_filt),
                   " stall sites (p \u2264 ", MIN_PVALUE,
                   ", sf \u2265 ", MIN_SF, ") — CM class"),
    x = NULL, y = "Stall sites"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 10))

print(p_output)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "output_flaviviridae_stalls_cm.pdf"),
       p_output, width = 6.5, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "output_flaviviridae_stalls_cm.png"),
       p_output, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

### 5c. Combined panel

```{r fig_combined, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 4}
p_combined <- (p_input + p_output) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p_combined)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "flaviviridae_input_output_cm.pdf"),
       p_combined, width = 13, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "flaviviridae_input_output_cm.png"),
       p_combined, width = 13, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
